'''Battle Frontier Challenge: The Flute Cup!''' (Japanese: '''激闘のホウエン地方! 挑戦バトルフロンティア!!''' ''The Hoenn Region, Site of Fierce Fights! The Battle Frontier Challenge!!'') is the third chapter of the {{ma|Pokémon Journeys}} manga. It is based on the ''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]'' episode ''[[JN007|Serving Up the Flute Cup!]]''.

==Plot==
{{Incomplete plot}}

==Major events==
* {{Ash}} and [[Goh]] visit [[Hoenn]] to participate in the [[Battle Frontier Flute Cup]], which Ash wins.
* Goh is revealed to have {{pkmn2|caught}} a {{p|Caterpie}}, {{p|Butterfree}}, {{p|Weedle}}, {{p|Kakuna}}, {{TP|Goh|Beedrill}}, {{p|Parasect}}, {{TP|Goh|Pinsir}}, and {{TP|Goh|Scyther}}.
* Ash is revealed to have a [[Mimey|Mr. Mime]].
* Goh has his first {{pkmn|Trainer}} {{pkmn|battle}} and loses.

==Differences between the animated series and the manga==
* [[Goh]]'s {{TP|Goh|Caterpie}}, {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Butterfree}}, {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Weedle}}, {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Weedle|Kakuna}}, {{TP|Goh|Beedrill}}, {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Paras|Parasect}}, {{TP|Goh|Pinsir}}, and {{TP|Goh|Scyther}} debut here as the events of ''[[JN006|Working My Way Back to Mew!]]'' were skipped.
* [[Mimey]] debuts here, as its appearances in ''[[JN002|Legend? Go! Friends? Go!]]'' were omitted in ''[[JNM01|Legend? Check! Friends? Check!]]''.
* [[Hibana]] is omitted.
* Goh doesn't leave to {{pkmn2|caught|catch}} a {{TP|Goh|Taillow}}. As such, he and {{Ash}} meet [[Hodge]] at the same time. He also doesn't catch three {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Dustox|Wurmple}}.
* Ash doesn't receive a prize for winning the tournament.
